newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico TIIE 28-day rate falls to 26.0050 pct.
newsitem.headline: Mexico TIIE 28-day rate falls to 26.0050 pct.

text.p: Mexico's 28-day interbank interest rate (TIIE) fell to 26.005 percent Wednesday from Tuesday's rate of 26.10 percent, Mexican Stock Exchange said.
Mexico's 28-day interbank interest rate (TIIP) meanwhile rose to 26.0720 percent on Wednesday against 25.9069 percent.
TIIE is a market-weighted average interbank rate, revised daily.
TIIP, which is being phased out in favor of the TIIE, is also a market-weighted average interbank rate, but revised weekly.
